newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea to absorb 400 billion won in repos.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea to absorb 400 billion won in repos.

text.p: South Korea's central Bank of Korea said on Friday it would absorb 400 billion won through repurchase agreements in the next seven days.
The bank said liquidity was high as a result of money supply from the state budget.
"There is a surplus of funds among banks," a Bank of Korea official said.
Overnight call rate fell to 12.2/12.3 percent in the afternoon, from Thursday's closing of 12.48 percent.
Brokers said liquidity rose as banks were reluctant to extend loans on fears of corporate failures after the collapse of the Hanbo Steel Co in January.
